{{Quote|Who or what are the Ur'kossags?''"<br />"''A gang. Named themselves after a Huttese word for&hellip; you don't want to know.|Carsen to her Master|<ref name="Merciful One" />}}
The '''Ur'kossags''' were a criminal gang on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Named after a word from the [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] [[Language/Legends|language]], the Ur'kossags robbed and [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] in the [[Network Access]] sector, but the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] girl [[Kira Carsen]] stood up to the gang in defense of her friends<ref name="Merciful One" /> sometime between [[3653 BBY|3653]]&ndash;[[3645 BBY]].<ref name="Time" /> The group attempted to recruit Carsen, asking her to kill a [[Unidentified gangster|rival gangster]], but the teenage refugee refused and killed the criminals instead, ending the threat to her friends. However, Carsen's attack gave the refugees a fearsome reputation, and the group found it difficult to acquire supplies in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] afterwards. Carsen later learned of this when she and [[Hero of Tython|her Jedi Master]] visited the refugees to deliver relief supplies<ref name="Merciful One" /> in [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> but she did not regret her actions.<ref name="Merciful One" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ur'Kossags were first mentioned on [[the Holonet]] section of the official site for the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in the entry for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class' companion character Kira Carsen,<ref name="Time" /> although they were not named until the conversation "The Merciful One" in the game itself.<ref name="Merciful One" />
